## About
We're a fully licensed electronics shop on S Cicero Ave in Oak Lawn. We carry a big selection of televisions, and we handle the work that comes after the sale: wall mounts, antennas, TV service and wiring.
People also come to us for TV repair, laptop and computer help, and setting up DIRECTV, Xfinity and Sling TV. If you run a business, our services can be applied to commercial installs too.
Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 241 Google reviews. Stop in or give us a call for your next deal.

## Services
- Televisions: We are an authorized LG and Samsung dealer and carry all major brands of televisions.
- Installs & wall mounts: Flat mounts, articulated mounts and custom fishing to hide the wires.
- TV repair: Bring in your TV and we will walk you through the repair process with honest feedback.
- New antenna: We replace damaged antennas, ground them properly, and can add a line to another TV in the house.
- DIRECTV: Hassle free, next day DIRECTV installation from a local DIRECTV retailer.
- Xfinity: Internet, in-home WiFi and other Xfinity services, bundled on one plan.
- Sling TV: We are a Sling TV authorized dealer.
- Viruses and hard drives: Computer and laptop help with viruses and hard drive trouble.
- Commercial installs: Our services can be applied to custom and electric commercial installs.

## FAQ
Q: Where should I park when I visit?
A: Please use the Denny's parking lot when visiting the shop. You will not be towed.

Q: Are you licensed?
A: Yes. We are fully licensed and equipped to offer a full range of electronic and install services.
